displayName: Markdown Share / Publish MD as Web Page
description: Share Markdown as a beautiful web page on htmlto.link with a local live preview and 33 templates. Open any .md and click Share; guest links last ~24h, set a Token for longer-lived shares.
configuration.title: Quick Markdown Share
config.apiBaseUrl: Base URL of the htmlto.link share API.
config.autoCopyUrl: Automatically copy the public URL after a successful share.
config.openInBrowser: Open the share link in the browser after success.
config.enableTelemetry: Allow anonymous activation telemetry to help improve the extension.
